title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 50 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 50)

content.overview: Section 50 specifies the orders from which an appeal lies in relation to a foreign award under Chapter I, principally orders refusing to refer parties to arbitration under section 45 and orders refusing enforcement under section 48. No second appeal lies except to the Supreme Court.

content.study:
Section 50 — Appealable orders

Section 50 specifies the orders from which an appeal lies in relation to a foreign award under Chapter I, principally orders refusing to refer parties to arbitration under section 45 and orders refusing enforcement under section 48. No second appeal lies except to the Supreme Court.

The Part II analysis must begin with the statutory definition and the Convention framework, then identify the exact condition or enforcement ground engaged. The statutory grounds should not be expanded by general merits review.
